question: Should this safety-critical retry change require live GitHub Actions replay evidence before the draft is marked ready?
rationale: The patch and tests are coherent, but only a real failed-run or requeue exercise can demonstrate artifact publication, retrieval, and execution-gate behavior on the hosted Actions path.

options.title: Require live replay proof
options.body: Run a plan-only replay and an unavailable-artifact recovery in GitHub Actions, confirming the original inputs are retained and the fallback cannot execute.

options.title: Accept test coverage
options.body: Rely on the focused regression suite and green workflow checks, accepting that hosted artifact behavior will first be validated after merge.

recommendation.title: Require live replay proof
recommendation.body: Run a plan-only replay and an unavailable-artifact recovery in GitHub Actions, confirming the original inputs are retained and the fallback cannot execute.

likelyOwner.reason: His history is most closely connected to the existing repair requeue workflow and its execution safety behavior.
